# Get CAdata from old version of MapGAM

```{r}
install.packages("remotes", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
remotes::install_github("cran/MapGAM")
library(MapGAM)
data("CAdata")
saveRDS(CAdata, "CAdata.rds")
```
